text: Apollo.io is a venture-capital-backed go-to-market software company based in San Francisco. In August 2023 it raised $100M in Series D funding led by Bain Capital Ventures, with participation from existing investors Sequoia Capital, Tribe Capital and Nexus Venture Partners.
short: Apollo.io: VC-backed (Bain Capital Ventures, Sequoia, Tribe, Nexus).

source.name: Apollo.io Magazine – 'Apollo.io Secures $100 Million Series D at $1.6B Valuation to Drive World-Class GTM'
source.quote: raised $100M in Series D funding led by Bain Capital Ventures (BCV), with participation from existing investors Sequoia Capital, Tribe Capital, and Nexus Venture Partners
